_note: Hand-written notes for items nobody hand-rated. data/item-stats.json carries a sourced one-line description of what each item does; these say whether it is worth a pick, which is a different question and the only one this game asks. A five-item draft judged on thirteen boss fights is unkind to the run economy: pills, trinkets, coins, keys and extra rooms are most of what Isaac gives you and almost none of it kills anything. Where that is true these notes say so, because a player deserves to know why the strongest-looking item in the offer scores nothing. Ordered roughly by how often an item actually appears in an offer.

notes.COLLECTIBLE_PLAN_C: Kills the room, then kills you three seconds later. One free boss and the run ends there — the odds engine counts the fight you win, not the one you never reach.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_RED_KEY: Extra rooms are extra items on a real run. Across five fixed picks there is nothing behind the door.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_MOMS_BOTTLE_OF_PILLS: A pill is a coin flip you have to swallow. Nothing here shoots.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_MOMS_COIN_PURSE: Four pills, four coin flips. The maths is the same as one.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_MOMS_BOX: A trinket and doubled trinket effects. Trinkets are a whole economy this draft does not have.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_PORTABLE_SLOT: Coins into a machine. Machines do not fight Mom.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_MOMS_KEY: Chests pay better and you get two keys. Both are currencies you will never spend here.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_MR_ME: Sends a helper to press something for you. Nothing in a boss room needs pressing.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_FLIP: Two items per pedestal doubles a real run's take. In a draft the pedestal is already chosen for you.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_THE_NECRONOMICON: Forty damage to the room, on a charge. It genuinely kills things, which puts it well ahead of most of this list, and Book Worm makes it fire twice.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_BOOK_OF_SECRETS: Treasure Map, Compass or Blue Map for the floor. Knowing where the rooms are does not help you survive them.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_CURSE_OF_THE_TOWER: Six troll bombs every time you are hit. That is a punishment for taking damage, in a fight you take damage in.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_SATANIC_BIBLE: A black heart on demand, and it turns boss items into devil deals. The heart is real; the deals are a run you are not playing.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_GUPPYS_TAIL: Chests, mostly. Worth taking for the guppy tag and almost nothing else — which is exactly the trade a transformation asks you to make.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_SPINDOWN_DICE: Rerolls pedestals down the item list. A famous engine on a real run; here there is no pedestal to point it at.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_MOMS_PURSE: One trinket. See Mom's Box, and expect less.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_MAGIC_SKIN: Trades a heart for a broken one and spawns an item. You pay in the currency the boss model actually counts.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_GIMPY: Hearts on hit and enemies dropping hearts. Sustain rather than damage, which is worth more here than most of this list.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_BUTT_BOMBS: Five bombs, and each one confuses the room and hits everything for ten. Bombs are finite, but ten to every enemy is real damage.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_REMOTE_DETONATOR: Five bombs you choose the timing of. Better than bombs, still bombs.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_DADS_KEY: Opens almost anything. There is nothing locked between you and Mother.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_GUPPYS_HEAD: Two to four blue flies on a charge. Chip damage that also carries the guppy tag, which is the real reason to take it.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_GUPPYS_PAW: Turns a heart container into three soul hearts. A straight defensive gain, and a third of a Guppy.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_MONSTER_MANUAL: A random familiar for the floor. Whatever it rolls fights alongside you, which is more than most actives manage.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_MOMS_EYESHADOW: Charm tears, sometimes. A charmed enemy stops shooting at you and starts shooting at its friends.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_ABYSS: Eats the items in the room and gives you locusts. The locusts fight; the items you fed it were your other picks.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_VOID: Eats pedestals for stats. On a real run it is one of the best items in the game — here you have five picks and nothing to spare.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_KEEPERS_BOX: A shop item, free. Which item is the whole question, and this does not answer it.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_MOMS_BRACELET: Lets you pick up rocks and throw them. Cute, and not a boss plan.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_SACRED_ORB: Deletes the bottom of the item pool for the rest of the run. Enormous over twenty items; over five it is one pick you did not spend on damage.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_THE_BOOK_OF_SIN: A pickup, on a charge. It also carries the book tag, which is the only reason it is ever the right take.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_A_QUARTER: Twenty-five cents. There is no shop at the end of this.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_GUPPYS_EYE: Shows you what is inside chests. Fourth of the Guppy family and the weakest of them, but it counts the same.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_METRONOME: One random item's effect, briefly. Sometimes Brimstone, usually not.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_CAR_BATTERY: Every active fires twice. Worth exactly as much as the actives you are already holding, and nothing at all if you hold none.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_JUMPER_CABLES: Charge from kills instead of rooms. Same caveat as Car Battery: it multiplies something you may not have.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_MAMA_MEGA: Two hundred damage to every room in the floor, once. That is several fights deleted, and then it is gone.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_BATTERY_PACK: Refills your active and hands you three batteries. Charge is only worth what it charges.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_SHARP_PLUG: Pays health for charge. A real cost against a boss model that counts health.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_WOODEN_NICKEL: A coin, half the time. No.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_BOOK_OF_THE_DEAD: Turns your kills into orbitals and charmed Bonies. Everything it makes is fighting on your side, which is rare on this list.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_BOOK_OF_VIRTUES: A wisp per use, and the wisps inherit whatever active you are holding. It builds a wall of small attackers that never stops growing.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_BETRAYAL: Enemies hit by crossfire turn on each other. Genuine damage that costs you nothing to deal.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_BLOOD_RIGHTS: Forty damage to everything, paid in your own hearts. Both halves of that are counted here.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_BROWN_NUGGET: A fly turret at three and a half damage a shot. Small, permanent, and pointed at the enemy.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_D10: Devolves everything in the room into something weaker. A boss is not a room, which is where this stops helping.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_KAMIKAZE: Half a heart for a hundred and eighty-five damage explosion, centred on you. The number is enormous; so is standing in it.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_THE_BEAN: A poison fart. Twenty-six damage if the target is already poisoned, five if not, and you have to be close either way.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_BLACK_POWDER: Walk a circle, get a pentagram doing ten a tick. Everything about that sentence assumes you have room to walk it.
notes.COLLECTIBLE_A_POUND_OF_FLESH: Rewrites what shops and devil deals cost. Every price it changes is one you never pay here.
